scope: Remove obsolete table mutation APIs and missing-context branches after production caller migration. Keep meaningful tests on the live owners. No complete package or new finding acceptance.

caller_review.remaining_production_mutation_callers: driver/dml/update_record.rs, driver/dml/delete_record.rs and foreign_key.rs already use StmtContext APIs. All former production calls selected Some(ctx).

changes: Direct statement ownership of mutation flags, staged writes and statistics; delete-with-old routes the retained row once instead of twice.
Two existing CHECK/index tests use the live DML APIs; every behavioral assertion retained. No tests or harnesses added.
Replace obsolete storage module future-work narrative with current memory/cluster backend ownership. Correct references to the removed DDL wrapper.

commands.command: cargo test --locked -p tidb-executor --lib -- kv_table::tests:: cluster_storage::tests:: foreign_key modify_column delete update --test-threads=1

not_run: Live multi-node TiKV or repeated wire suite
Compile-time or runtime benchmark comparison; no measured speedup claim
validation.publication: Actual locked-build hook, fresh pre-push build and remote SHA are recorded after the commit in /workspace/.cloud-setup/mutation-cleanup-batch/final-handoff.json.
